name: gradient-score
description: A smoothness score for CSS gradients, shown above each gradient with located findings, quick fixes and a swatch preview. Local only: no network, no telemetry. Working name.
author: LightSeek3r (https://github.com/LightSeek3r)

opal42.minScore.markdownDescription: Optional smoothness score (0-100) below which a gradient's diagnostics are shown as errors. **No default**: leave it unset and diagnostics keep the severity of the finding (information or warning). It changes severity only; nothing is blocked.

opal42.showSkipped.markdownDescription: Show a lens ("Not scored - ...") above gradients that cannot be scored: `var()`, `calc()`, transparency, hard stops, repeating, radial and conic gradients, and so on.

opal42.codeLens.enabled.description: Show the smoothness score above each scored gradient.

opal42.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report the findings of the score as diagnostics on the stops that cause them.

opal42.maxFileSizeKB.description: Documents larger than this many kilobytes are not analysed.

opal42.studioUrl.markdownDescription: Address of the Gradient Studio web app opened by **Opal42: Open in Gradient Studio**. Only opened when you run that command. Must start with `https://` or `http://`.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
